selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Arcane Recovery
selectedAndAutomaticCards.duration: Instantaneous during a completed short rest
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Arcane Recovery. Tags: base, passive, resonance. Once between long rests when you complete a short rest, restore RP equal to half your Wizard class level rounded up, never above your normal maximum. This is RP recovery, not a second pool, and cannot trigger spell-cast, Refrain or Dissonance effects.

source.originalText: Arcane Recovery: Once per day during a short rest, recover RP equal to half your Wizard level (rounded up), up to your normal maximum.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Spell Scribing
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Spell Scribing. Tags: base, passive, spellbook. Copying a legal found Wizard spell into your spellbook requires 1 hour and 25 gp of inks and components per spell rank, treating rank 0 as rank 1 for this calculation, instead of the pilot baseline 2 hours and 50 gp. Level-up spells remain free.

source.originalText: Spell Scribing: Copy spells into your spellbook at half the normal cost and time.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Arcane Insight
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-wizards.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Matrix Efficiency
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Scholarly Mind
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

source.originalText: Scholarly Mind: Gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to arcane knowledge.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Arcane Bolt
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Arcane Bolt. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, universal, damage. Make a Wizard spell attack. On a hit deal S d6 + M force damage. Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Bolt: Launch a bolt of pure arcane energy that deals force damage to a single target.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Minor Conjuration
selectedAndAutomaticCards.frequency: At will while RP remains; one object at a time
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Minor Conjuration. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, conjuration. Create one nonmagical unattended object that fits inside a 1-foot cube, weighs no more than 10 pounds and is made of common nonvaluable material such as wood, cloth, clay, iron or glass. It cannot be food, poison, currency, a spell component with listed cost, ammunition with special properties or a functional complex mechanism. Creating another dismisses the first.

source.originalText: Minor Conjuration: Create a temporary, small inanimate object that lasts for 1 hour.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Analyze Magic
selectedAndAutomaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One magical creature, object or effect within 30 feet
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Analyze Magic. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, divination, knowledge. Make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10 + the effect's spell rank, treating a non-spell effect's Director-assigned tier as rank. On success learn its school or magical category, one active mechanical property and whether it is currently sustained, cursed or bound to another effect. Failure reveals only that magic is present.

source.originalText: Analyze Magic: Study a magical effect or item to gain insight into its properties and function.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Spellbook Study
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

source.originalText: Spellbook Study: Spend time studying your spellbook to prepare a different selection of spells.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Floating Preparation
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

source.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Sigil Rewrite
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

source.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Matrix Mastery
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Arcane Tradition
selectedAndAutomaticCards.frequency: Automatic at Wizard 3; not a selection
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Arcane Tradition. Tags: arch, school, automatic. Your level-1 Arcane School becomes your Arcanist tradition; do not choose a second school. Prepare one additional matrix from that same school each day without counting it against your normal prepared-matrix maximum. It otherwise obeys all ordinary rank, spellbook, Dissonance and duplicate-family rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Improved Concentration
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

source.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Counterspell
selectedAndAutomaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Arcane Lock
selectedAndAutomaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Dispel Magic
selectedAndAutomaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Dimensional Pocket
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

source.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Arcane Sight
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Spell Preservation
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Spell Preservation. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, spellbook. Your primary spellbook cannot be destroyed, erased or rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. It can still be stolen, hidden, transported, suppressed, sealed by an artifact-level effect or voluntarily abandoned. Copies and backup books do not automatically receive this protection.

source.originalText: Spell Preservation: Your spellbook cannot be destroyed by non-artifact means.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Runic Snare
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Runic Snare. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, glyph, control. Place a visible-to-you glyph. The first hostile creature entering the square makes a Dexterity save. Failure deals S d6 force damage, causes Restrained until the end of its next turn and makes it drop one non-attuned held item of its choice. Success takes half damage with no restraint or drop. A Restrained target may repeat a Strength save at the end of its turn.

source.originalText: Runic Snare: Glyph trap explodes in a 2x2 root + disarm on trigger

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Counterpulse
selectedAndAutomaticCards.rangeAndTarget: Caster whose spell you successfully Counterspelled
selectedAndAutomaticCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Counterpulse. Tags: hero, spellbinder, counter, control. Immediately after your Counterspell succeeds, spend 1 RP. The countered caster is Silenced until the end of its next turn. This is part of the successful counter event rather than another spell cast and cannot trigger another Counterpulse.

source.originalText: Counterpulse: Countering a spell silences the caster for 1 round

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Spell Absorption
selectedAndAutomaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One hostile spell that directly targets you
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Spell Absorption. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, abjuration. Trigger after you become the target of a hostile spell but before it resolves. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell rank. On success that spell has no effect on you, though it resolves normally against other targets, and you gain temporary HP equal to spell rank + M. On failure it resolves normally and the use is spent.

source.originalText: Spell Absorption: Absorb a hostile spell, gaining temporary hit points equal to the spell's level.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Elemental Affinity
selectedAndAutomaticCards.duration: Permanent until changed by Core Sync
selectedAndAutomaticCards.frequency: Automatic when Elementalist is chosen; counts as one level-10 Hero acquisition
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Elemental Affinity. Tags: hero, elementalist, elemental, automatic. Choose Fire, Cold, Lightning or Earth when entering Elementalist. Fire corresponds to fire damage, Cold to cold, Lightning to lightning and Earth to magical bludgeoning damage created by earth effects. Wizard spells matching the affinity gain +2 to their Wizard save DC or +2 on their spell attack, as applicable, and once per spell add one extra die matching that spell's primary damage die to one damage roll.

source.originalText: Elemental Affinity: Choose 1 element (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth); all spells of that element gain +2 DC, +1 damage tier

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Ritual Casting
selectedAndAutomaticCards.cost: 0 RP unless the individual ritual explicitly states otherwise
selectedAndAutomaticCards.frequency: At will outside encounters with sufficient time
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5184. Cast a Wizard spell bearing the Ritual tag directly from your spellbook without preparing it. Increase its casting time by at least 10 minutes. Ritual Casting cannot be completed during an encounter, does not use an ordinary prepared-matrix position and does not generate or vent normal casting Dissonance.

source.originalText: | 2 | Counterspell Reaction, Ritual Casting |

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: School Mastery
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5186. This is the one School Mastery progression grant, not a second school choice or duplicate feat. Increase the level-1 Arcane School spell-attack and spell-save bonus from +1 to +2 total. Its school passive and bonus-spell rules otherwise remain unchanged.

source.originalText: | 5 | Bonus Feat: School Mastery |

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Arcane Ward
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5187. After preparing spells, choose one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, radiant or thunder that is dealt by at least one prepared spell of your Arcane School. Gain resistance to that damage type until your next long rest. If none of your prepared school spells deals a damage type, choose force. This is provisional completion of the source's ambiguous 'chosen school's element' wording.

source.originalText: | 6 | Arcane Ward (resistance to chosen school's element) |

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Dual Cast
selectedAndAutomaticCards.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

source.originalText: | 9 | Dual Cast (cast 2 Tier 1–2 spells in a round) |

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Overchannel
selectedAndAutomaticCards.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
selectedAndAutomaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5190. Cast one prepared spell as though it were one rank higher than the highest rank at which you could normally cast that SAME spell, provided the spell has an explicit higher-rank scaling rule. Overchannel does not teach or prepare a higher-rank spell, cannot exceed effective rank 9 and cannot be combined with another generic Overcast rule during this pilot. All normal Dissonance/Refrain rules still apply.

source.originalText: | 13 | Overchannel (cast a spell 1 tier higher once/day) |

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Arcane Feedback
selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5191, converted from historical slot wording to RP. After your Counterspell successfully negates a spell, restore 1 RP, never above your normal maximum. A counter produced by a companion, reflected spell or copied Counterspell does not trigger this feature.

source.originalText: | 15 | Arcane Feedback (after successfully countering a spell, recover 1 RP once per round) |

selectedAndAutomaticCards.effect: Conviction Pool. Tags: conviction, passive. Increase your Conviction maximum by 2. This changes only the maximum; it does not immediately restore spent Conviction when acquired during play. A long rest restores Conviction to the new maximum.

source.originalText: Fervent Ritualist: +10% faster channel speed on all Rites.

selectedAndAutomaticCards.frequency: Automatic only if Radiance was selected

selectedAndAutomaticCards.name: Veil

# Cave Bear

**Family:** Wild Fauna
**Knowledge status:** Established Field Record
**Publication classification:** Public
**Dungeon range:** T1, Floors 1-10
**Primary source:** Haven Rangers’ Field Ledger and caravan-master kill reports
**Reliability:** High
**Encounter role:** Predator or pressure creature

## What It Is

Cave Bear is a dungeon-adapted predator or hazard. Its behavior remains rooted in food, territory, nesting, and escape, which gives a prepared Expedition more options than a direct fight.

## What Experienced Expeditions Notice

Scratches at the creature’s true height; prey dragged away rather than consumed in place; mineral dust in droppings; repeated avoidance of a seemingly safe route. Prey trails stop abruptly where the animal begins carrying rather than feeding.

## Creature Knowledge

Use **Nature** unless the Director approves a more specific approach.

| Result | Information Learned |
|---|---|
| DC 11 | Creature family, usual habitat, and dominant attack type. |
| DC 15 | The first reliable counter and the sign that its strongest ability is ready. |
| DC 19 | Its defining tactical weakness, safe harvest method, and likely retreat condition. |

## Knowledge Status and Reliability

**Status:** Established Field Record  
**Primary source:** Haven Rangers’ Field Ledger and caravan-master kill reports  
**Reliability:** High  
**Last confirmed:** Current Opening and prior guild registries  
**Confirmed range:** Floors 1-10  
**Rumored range:** Regional variants may extend beyond the confirmed range

## Stat Block

**Large Beast, Unaligned**  
**Challenge** 2 (450 XP budget) · **Dungeon Range** T1 · **Floors** 1-10
**Armor** 13 · **Hit Points** 68 · **Speed** 40 ft.

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 16 (+3) | 14 (+2) | 13 (+1) | 3 (-4) | 12 (+1) | 6 (-2) |

**Resistances** None  
**Immunities** None  
**Condition Immunities** None  
**Tactical Vulnerability** None identified  
**Save DC** 13  

### Traits

**Territorial Morale.** It may retreat or break off if food, young, or escape access is secured.

### Actions

**Multiattack.** The creature makes 2 attacks using the actions below.

**Mauling Claws.** *Attack:* +5 to hit, one target. *Hit:* 1d10+2 slashing damage (average 8).

## How It Fights

It opens with **Mauling Claws** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Bite** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. It attacks from concealment, protects its escape path, and stops pursuing once territory or food is secured.

## How to Defeat It

**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for slashing, piercing damage.
- Carry bait, scent control, and a noncombat retreat route.

**Combat Priority**

Control its escape and feeding choices rather than cornering it.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **None identified**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.

## Habitat, Goals, and Lair

Predators choose terrain that hides approach and protects retreat. The lair is usually more dangerous than the animal.

Not every dangerous creature serves a faction or cosmic principle. Ordinary predators become expedition-level threats when dungeon terrain, repeated Openings, or magical food chains reshape them.

Animal Handling, food, territory, and nonthreatening movement matter more than language.

## Treasure and Harvest

**Harvest skill:** Nature · **Harvest DC:** 10 · **Base time:** 30 minutes  

| Component | Tier | Drop / Value |
|---|---:|---|
| Bear meat | 1 | 54%, 12 gp base |
| Bear bone shard | 2 | 45%, 24 gp base |

**Known recipe links:** Greater Bear Bone Shard Stew.

Hide, meat, bone, venom, teeth, and organs are practical resources. Damage type and preservation method determine quality.

## Variants and Encounter Use

Change hunger, territory, age, injury, and nesting condition. Environmental behavior is the primary variant system.

# Deep Dwarf Kavalrachni

**Family:** Deep Folk
**Knowledge status:** Established Field Record
**Publication classification:** Public
**Dungeon range:** T1, Floors 1-10
**Primary source:** Haven treaty archives, captured correspondence, and parley reports
**Reliability:** High
**Encounter role:** Skirmisher or social adversary

## What It Is

Deep Dwarf Kavalrachni is an intelligent floor-dweller with territorial, religious, or political motives. Directors should establish what it protects before combat, because defeating it may create a worse enemy or close a valuable route.

## What Experienced Expeditions Notice

Masonry repaired from the inside; water channels marked with votive cuts; discarded fungi sorted by toxicity; warning bolts deliberately embedded at eye level.

## Creature Knowledge

Use **History or Insight** unless the Director approves a more specific approach.

| Result | Information Learned |
|---|---|
| DC 11 | Creature family, usual habitat, and dominant attack type. |
| DC 15 | The first reliable counter and the sign that its strongest ability is ready. |
| DC 19 | Its defining tactical weakness, safe harvest method, and likely retreat condition. |

## Knowledge Status and Reliability

**Status:** Established Field Record  
**Primary source:** Haven treaty archives, captured correspondence, and parley reports  
**Reliability:** High  
**Last confirmed:** Current Opening and prior guild registries  
**Confirmed range:** Floors 1-10  
**Rumored range:** Regional variants may extend beyond the confirmed range

## Stat Block

**Medium Humanoid, Lawful Neutral**  
**Challenge** 3 (700 XP budget) · **Dungeon Range** T1 · **Floors** 1-10
**Armor** 14 · **Hit Points** 88 · **Speed** 40 ft.

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 12 (+1) | 14 (+2) | 14 (+2) | 12 (+1) | 12 (+1) | 11 (+0) |

**Resistances** None  
**Immunities** None  
**Condition Immunities** None  
**Tactical Vulnerability** None identified  
**Save DC** 11  

### Traits

**Prepared Ground.** It gains advantage on the first attack or check made from a fortified position in its lair.

### Actions

**Precise Cut.** *Attack:* +5 to hit, one target. *Hit:* 2d6+2 slashing damage (average 9).

## How It Fights

It opens with **Precise Cut** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses prepared cover and retreats behind the next defensive layer when the first is lost.

## How to Defeat It

**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for slashing damage.
